reason: HaloPSA already tells me which agreements are underwater, and I'm not paying a monthly fee for something I can mostly see myself. I might run the free audit out of curiosity, but nobody in my peer group has mentioned Headroom and I won't be the first to pay for an unknown UK startup.
objection: It's uploads only, so it's a one-off health check rather than something I'd keep paying for every month. Plus I'd be handing contract PDFs and client lists to a company nobody I know has vetted. And £4,281 over six months on a 15-client demo is a made-up number.
would_change_my_mind: A couple of owners in my peer group showing me real money they recovered from it, ideally with a direct HaloPSA and Xero integration so it runs without me exporting CSVs.
